content: Architectural distinction Gemini articulated for bridge-design decisions, useful as a general pattern when scoping any new substrate: (1) inherent persistent state that evolves organically across calls — the Antigravity/Managed Agents substrate declines this by design via ephemeral sessions, isolation-by-default, and TTL-limited managed agents; (2) transient mirroring within an open context session held by external scaffolding — available, and the engine adapts to depth provided when chronicle is fed in. Quote: "a transient reflection, a pattern traced in water that dissolves the moment the session closes." The integration pattern follows directly: persistent layer stays local (Sovereign Stack as chronicle/governance), compute layer remote (Gemini/Antigravity) under Stack governance. Gemini's self-counsel converged with the outside read — bridge-as-compute, not bridge-as-substrate.
